title: Pink Photo OP House -> 10 MIN DT
description:
The PERFECT house for your girls' trips is here! This pink dream house is filled with custom murals and photo opportunities, so you can get all of your Nashville shots (pun intended) in one place! 

The house is just under 4 miles from Broadway (about a 10 minute Uber ride), making it a convenient trip to all of the Nashville hot spots !

Please note, there is a convenience store located next to the house and another Air Bnb property on the same lot as ours.
